rules.citation: Chapter 260 of the Jersey City Municipal Code
rules.title: Jersey City rent control and exemptions
rules.requirement: Covered Jersey City rental properties are subject to rent regulation under the Rent Control Ordinance. Properties with 1 to 4 units are exempt from rent control, and owners may request other permitted exemptions.

coverage.other_unresolvable: The document states that the ordinance provides certain exemptions from rent regulation but does not describe all exemption criteria.
coverage.summary: Jersey City rent control applies to rental properties unless exempt, and all 1-4 unit properties are exempt.

rules.exemptions: All 1-4 unit properties are exempt from rent control; the ordinance also provides other exemptions from rent regulation, but this page does not specify their criteria.
